article.title: Police to prevent cognizable offences
article.content: Every police officer may interpose for the purpose of preventing, and shall, to the best of his ability, prevent, the commission of any cognizable offence.
article.html:
168Police to prevent cognizable offences

Section 168 · Chapter XII

Every police officer may interpose for the purpose of preventing, and shall, to the best of his ability, prevent, the commission of any cognizable offence.
